How to choose a workshop widget

By Sam Jansen, updated 2 May 2026

A workshop widget holds your work steady while you cut, sand and drill. This guide compares the sizes, materials and prices that matter, then answers the questions buyers ask us most.

What size widget do I need?

Most home workshops need a medium widget, which fits a standard bench and handles projects up to one metre.

Small widgets suit model makers and tight spaces. Large widgets are for professional benches where you clamp long boards or heavy steel every day.

Which material lasts longest?

Steel lasts longest, aluminium resists rust and weighs less, and plastic is the cheapest choice for occasional use.

MaterialLifespanPrice
Steel20 years60-80 euro
Aluminium12 years40-60 euro
Plastic4 years20-30 euro

Buying checklist

  • Measure your bench and its overhang.
  • Check the mounting pattern against the widget's base.
  • Compare the warranty length and the return policy.
